item.title: US alleges Russian spies organized $40K murder plot in capital
item.description: Five Russian intelligence operatives allegedly offered $40,000 to a US-based recruit to kill a Kremlin critic believed to live in Washington, DC.

item.title: Major Dem Donor: Harris Faces Difficult 2028 Path
item.description: LinkedIn co-founder Reid Hoffman, a major Democratic donor, said former Vice President Kamala Harris would face a challenging path if she ran for president in 2028.

item.title: FBI Foils Russian Plot for Targeted Killings on US Soil
Rep. Edwards: 'Nothing Ethical' About Ethics Process
item.description: Rep. Chuck Edwards, R-N.C., filed a formal complaint against House Ethics Committee leaders, alleging they violated committee rules during the investigation.
